$comment: Source for assets/audio/manifest.json. The build merges this with the measured sounds. Event names follow docs/plan.md section 3.3; S1's domain contract finalises them and S3 owns the real mapping, so everything here is advisory.
advisory: Suggested mapping only. Domain events follow docs/plan.md section 3.3 (final names come from the domain contract); presentation cues are shell moments that are not domain events. S3 owns the actual mapping.

effects.note: Every effect is mastered to its loudness tier, so play effects at bus volume 1.0 by default. playEffect has no per-call gain, so the mix is baked into the files.

music.note: Loops are mastered 8 to 11 LU under the feedback tier (practice is quietest), so music already sits under effects at equal bus volumes. Parent settings scale down from 1.0.

feedback.use: Answer chimes, coins, stars, stickers, unlocks, panes, gifts, fanfares

character.use: Dragon and boss voices, eating, eggs

soft.use: Miss, blocked and sleepy sounds: always gentle, never punishing

ui.use: Taps, keypad and screen transitions: frequent, so quiet

musicCalm.use: Practice loop: unobtrusive while the child thinks

voices.note: createNarration allows 16 active voices by default; a crossfade holds 2 music voices. Keep effects within about 12 and throttle bursts: a dropped effect rejects with a 'limit' error, so catch it and carry on.

coin.note: For 5 or more coins play coin-shower once instead of many coins.

sparkle-family.note: map-unlock, sticker, star-n, gift-open: do not stack more than two

answer.correct.note: Play chime-n for the n-th correct answer in a row, holding at chime-5; any miss restarts at chime-1. The notes climb a C major pentatonic ladder, so overlapping tails always agree.

answer.incorrect.note: A soft, curious 'hmm?' (never a buzzer), with the orange '?' and 'Almost! Let's look...'.

item.promoted.note: Silent: it lands on the same answer as the chime.

level.completed.note: Play level-complete, then star-1, star-2, star-3 for each star earned, about 0.4 s apart as each star appears.

dragon.hatched.note: Wobble while the egg rocks, crack as the shell breaks, then the fanfare as the hatchling appears.

dragon.grew.note: Magic sparkle during the growth animation, then a happy chirp.

dragon.crowned.note: The biggest fanfare, reused for crowning.

pane.lit.note: Several panes lighting at once: stagger them by 150 ms or more, at most 3 overlapping.

coins.earned.note: coin for 1 to 4 coins, coin-shower for 5 or more (one sound, not many coins).

finale.completed.note: Then switch the music state to finale.

ui.blocked.note: A locked level, an unaffordable item or an invalid move.

fx.dragon-eating.note: Feeding Time: when the fruit reaches the dragon after a correct answer, about 0.3 s after the chime.

fx.dragon-sleepy.note: After the daily goal, when the dragons get sleepy.

fx.boss-laugh.note: Boss Challenge: when a correct answer fills the boss's laughing or happy meter.

music.note: setAtmosphere({ packId, asset, fadeSeconds: 1.2 }) on state change; the same state is idempotent. Pass null for explicit silence (for example while read-aloud speaks, or if the parent turns music off).
